expires_today.title: Redline Racing Bundle
expires_today.description: Breakneck speed is all you need
expires_today.long_description:
Buckle up for a furiously fast collection of unique and exciting racing games with the Redline Racing Bundle! Play Assetto Corsa Competizione, the official GT World Challenge video game experience, and more. Hit curves at top speeds in Art of Rally, a stylized, top-down take on rally car racing, compete on the iconic tracks of Japan’s legendary EBISU circuit in Drift CE, or try extreme downhill freeriding in Descenders, a bike racer where mistakes have real consequences! Dominate the tracks and help support the Starlight Children’s Foundation with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before June 26th, 2027.

expires_within_72h.title: Hip Hop, Lofi & Trap Mega Bundle
expires_within_72h.long_description: The Hip Hop, Lofi & Trap Mega Bundle brings the energy with audio assets that keep the party going! Perfect for audio engineers of all levels, this bundle offers a little of everything from a wide variety of genres. Get the assets you need to achieve the perfect beat with Artifacts Boom Bap Samples, Lofi Hip Hop Breeze, and more! A strong bassline is like a healthy heartbeat—everyone needs one—pay what you want for the ultimate Hip Hop, Lofi, and Trap music bundle and help support the World Wildlife Fund with your purchase!

expires_within_72h.title: The All-in-One Unreal & Unity GameDev Bundle
expires_within_72h.long_description:
Build game environments with ease when you pay what you want for The All-in-One Unreal & Unity GameDev Bundle! Unleash your creativity with a wide range of asset packs that cater to any scenario imaginable—set a dark and mysterious scene with the Cappadocia Anatolian Cave Hotel Environment pack, the Sci-Fi Populate Environment pack, The Lords' Mansion pack, and more. Save big on cyberpunk cityscapes, Japanese shopping malls, and beyond—plus, your purchase helps support the Make-A-Wish Foundation!

Keys expire. Please redeem your Fab keys before July 6th, 2027, and your Unity keys before June 30th, 2027.

expires_within_72h.title: Professor DM's Dungeon Crawl Classics Essentials Bundle Presented by Dungeon Craft
expires_within_72h.description: This one’s for the dungeon crawlers
expires_within_72h.long_description:
If you’re an avid follower of Dungeon Craft or simply want to test your mettle on a new adventure, you’ll want to snag this bundle of TTRPG rulebooks, adventures, inspiration manuals, and more presented by the one, the only Professor DM! In this library of over 100 ebooks and PDFs, you’ll find Dungeon Crawl Classics adventures like The Croaking Fane and Intrigue at the Court of Chaos, eldritch alphabets, how-to manuals, horror and romance tales, and a lot more—even hard copies of four random adventures with your purchase! This bundle has everything you need and more to kick off your next campaign, so get it now at the price of your choice, and support St. Jude Children’s Hospital!

The titles in this bundle are available through DTRPG.

Keys expire. Please redeem your digital tier keys before June 29th, 2027, and your physical tier key before December 31st, 2026.

expires_within_72h.title: Fantasy Game Dev Assets By Synty
expires_within_72h.long_description:
Game developers, rejoice! The pros at Synty Studios are here to help you take your project from baseline to beta with our latest Software Bundle. Build your worlds with professional-quality assets like photorealistic particle effects, prepare for lifelike duels with a fantasy rival pack, and more. Add complex interfaces or simple dungeons—anything you need to help bring your dream game to life. You’ll even get a $10 voucher for the Synty Studios store to keep creating.
